Maker.ActionSummary: Read W:\PMCR-O\src\services\ProjectName.OrchestratorService\Services\McpToolCache.cs in full (504 lines) via Desktop Commander:read_file. Read W:\PMCR-O\Directory.Packages.props in full. Web-searched Desktop Commander's transport requirement.

GroundTruth.VerificationMethod: Direct file read of McpToolCache.cs + Directory.Packages.props on W:\PMCR-O via Desktop Commander MCP, cross-checked against a web search of Desktop Commander's own published documentation
GroundTruth.Evidence: McpToolCache.cs's CallMcp() method is a hand-rolled HttpClient POST to '/mcp' with manual JSON-RPC 2.0 envelope construction and manual SSE-framing parsing -- it does NOT use ModelContextProtocol's McpClient.CreateAsync/HttpClientTransport, despite Directory.Packages.props's inline comment claiming 'McpToolCache.cs's native-client rewrite (McpClient.CreateAsync + HttpClientTransport) is verified against the 1.4.0 API surface.' That comment describes work that is not present in the actual file. Separately, Desktop Commander (mcp.directory/servers/desktop-commander, mcp.directory/blog/desktop-commander-mcp-complete-guide-2026) runs exclusively over stdio transport -- 'npx -y @wonderwhy-er/desktop-commander', spawned as a local subprocess -- not HTTP. All three of McpToolCache's existing clients (_fsClient, _termClient, _pwClient) are HttpClient instances pointed at Aspire-hosted HTTP services. Neither existing code path can reach a stdio-spawned server without new client code using StdioClientTransport (from ModelContextProtocol.Protocol.Transport, already available in the pinned ModelContextProtocol 1.4.0 package).

Checker.Rationale: All three criteria answered with direct evidence, not inference. A new, unplanned finding surfaced: Directory.Packages.props contains a comment asserting a 'native-client rewrite' of McpToolCache.cs that the actual file does not contain -- documentation describing state that isn't true on disk, the same class of issue this repo's own Earned Constraints already name for conversational self-report, just found in a code comment instead of a chat transcript.
CriteriaEvaluated: McpToolCache.cs mechanism confirmed: hand-rolled HttpClient/JSON-RPC, not native SDK client
Desktop Commander transport confirmed: stdio subprocess (npx -y @wonderwhy-er/desktop-commander)
Compatibility confirmed: existing HTTP-based pattern cannot reach Desktop Commander; new StdioClientTransport code path required
